fieldValues.title: G1 Simple decision log
fieldValues.summary: A group records decisions with the four-field Quick Log blueprint while retaining a capable canonical Decision Record beneath it.
fieldValues.body:
## Group Need

We need a small shared form that lets us remember what we decided.

## Semantic Adds

- Decision Record
- four essential decision fields
- explicit absent rather than inferred information

## Blueprint Adds

- Quick Log editing form
- readable decision-log facet

## Does Not Introduce

- sessions or attendance
- formal roles or authority
- AI assistance

## Activation Trigger

A group wants to record and read back decisions without adopting a governance process.
